name: Gwyar

attributes.attribute: A Welsh goddess, the wife of the god of the sky.
Some tales call her a sister of king Arthur.
Elsewhere the name of Arthur's sister is Morgause or Morgan.
She had two sons, one good and one bad.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gwyar, also called Anna, was a Welsh goddess wed to the god of the sky. Her full story is lost, but her name, meaning gore, survives. Some say she was sister to king Arthur, though that sister is also named Morgause or Morgan. She bore two sons, one good and one bad.

okr.objective: Present Gwyar as a fragmentary Welsh sky goddess whose name, family, and two sons survive.
